2026-09-09-two-devices.title: One file, two devices
2026-09-09-two-devices.text: Open the same file on your computer and your phone: a change made on one shows up on the other within seconds, and edits to different parts of an idea are kept from both.

2026-09-09-start-over.title: Start over on this device
2026-09-09-start-over.text: Settings can disconnect this device from your ideas file without deleting it, handy on a shared computer.

2026-09-09-whats-new.title: What's new
2026-09-09-whats-new.text: This bell lists the features added since you last looked.

2026-09-09-languages.title: Four languages
2026-09-09-languages.text: The app now speaks Canadian and American English, French and Spanish; choose yours in Settings.

2026-09-09-phone-layout.title: Made for phones
2026-09-09-phone-layout.text: On a phone the matrix becomes a list of cards, with a tour of its own.
